exclusivePackage.pricingNotesEn: Weekdays: Mon-Thu; Weekends: Fri-Sun; Consecutive holidays begin from the eve of the holiday. Breakfast included (except Lunar New Year).

holidays.noteEn: Breakfast not included during Lunar New Year
